intro.title: Objects, Prototypes & Classes
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple program to manage a collection of books, each represented as an object with properties like title and author. You will learn how to create and manipulate JavaScript objects, which are fundamental data structures for storing key-value pairs. The lesson will then introduce prototypes to share methods between objects efficiently, and finally, you will use modern ES6 classes to create object blueprints with constructors and methods. By the end, you'll understand how objects, prototypes, and classes work together to organize code in JavaScript.
intro.usecase: Objects, prototypes, and classes are fundamental to organizing data and behavior in modern web applications. You'll use these concepts when building user profile systems where each user is an object instance with properties like name and email, and methods for updating preferences. In e-commerce applications, product catalogs use class-based structures to manage items with shared characteristics like price calculations and inventory tracking. Dashboard components often inherit from base UI classes to maintain consistent styling and behavior across charts, tables, and control panels.
